verdict.rationale: Sentry's alert docs say alerts can "call webhooks" when issues match pre-defined rules, including issues from projects or Monitors. That is the core of pointing alert notifications at an automated endpoint. Adjacent agent hooks also exist: Seer Autofix automates triage and creates fix PRs, and Seer can launch Cursor Cloud Agents. Missing for 10: documentation of webhook payload format, signing, retries or filtering; an explicit example of alert webhooks driving remediation or agents; independent or hands-on corroboration.
